description: Divides one clock nine ways at once, each division sending a 10ms pulse

params.text: Sets every division back to the start of its count, and holds them all there while it is held down

inputs.text: Steps every division on each rising edge, reading high above 1V and low at 0V or below
Sets every division back to the start of its count, and holds them all there while it stays high, which stops the module counting

outputs.text: A 10ms pulse each time its own division of the clock comes round, with a light beside it that is lit while its count is back at the start

notes: the nine divisions are 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 3, 5, 7 and 12, in that order down the panel, and each is printed beside its own output

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
